title: Alibaba, DeepSeek push China’s AI model race towards lower costs
summary: Alibaba launched Qwen3.8-Max with 2.4 trillion parameters using mixture-of-experts architecture, while DeepSeek released V4-Flash with competitive inference pricing. Both companies are driving down AI costs in China's intensifying model race.
problem_solved: Reducing AI model inference costs and making advanced AI more economically accessible
why_valuable: Lower AI costs democratize access to powerful models, enabling more businesses to leverage AI capabilities
